label: Convert task priority from string to integer

precheck.description: Check priority column is still text
precheck.sql:
SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND table_name = 'task'
        AND column_name = 'priority'
        AND data_type = 'text'
      LIMIT 1

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."task"
              ALTER COLUMN "priority" TYPE integer
              USING (
                CASE "priority"
                  WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2
                  WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3
                  WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 4
                END
              )

postcheck.sql:
SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND table_name = 'task'
        AND column_name = 'priority'
        AND data_type = 'integer'
      LIMIT 1

label: Convert task status from string to integer

precheck.description: Check status column is still text

SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND table_name = 'task'
        AND column_name = 'status'

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."task"
              ALTER COLUMN "status" TYPE integer
              USING (
                CASE "status"
                  WHEN 'TODO' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2
                  WHEN 'IN_REVIEW' THEN 3
                  WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 4
